answer: Because the timing is logged against the sable challenge, the echo audit can replay the wharf history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 151 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 726 identities would post 3298 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
